source: The 16 old signed tapes and terrain split already frozen in ../fit.json, six physical maps (12 games) fit and two whole different maps (four games) for first read. Transfer uses 64 previously registered roots across another 16 whole maps. Exclude every seed and physical terrain in first_win_dev and first_win_blend_dev. No live games opened.
inputs: Use existing bridge.features, public_enemy and cnet2_feat; during reconstruction only sim.obs(Sapling seat) goes to features. Simulate a shadow opponent view from public rosters and own accumulated carbon belief. Actual opponent commands and own simultaneous candidate/commands never supply a prefix or feature. All teacher labels are normalized original temperature-1 whole orders taken after the feature generation. On fit, use old deterministic rollout predictions to build decoder prefix; train only on actor-representable labels under this generated prefix; log all exclusions. Deployed scoring takes its own autoregressive predicted prefix. All official logged slots remain in evaluation denominator.
learn: Small one-hidden-layer tanh candidate with existing Numpy serving interface, 40 hidden units, fixed seed 118063, Adam lr=.002, batch 384, 32 epochs, single thread, no tuning on blind panels. No use of original Master weights or private observations. No new student weights; Sapling and own H8 rollout preserved.
accuracy: Compare same-source old and new free-running decode on every held turn with deterministic argmax; retain joint exact (including all bases), each role, collector load >=100, loaded return within 3 of home, contact with an opposing heavier collector within 2; save per game/map and generated decisions. Report no-order baseline and force actual active separate. Optional noise checks compare fixed H8 two streams in 64-root transfer.
transfer_gate: Fixed 64 archived paired roots, old source not used to fit parameters. Under the same two old per-UID Gumbel draws, improve at least two of three pooled actual-command measures: planter, collector load>=100, entire opponent team. Also require four earlier H8 reserve maps new official-margin gain vs archived parent >= old H8 on those maps, and at least two with positive new gains. These gates are diagnostic on known historical roots, never estimates of repeated search policy whole-game win.
artifacts: weights + training/held bytes-bound provenance first, plus separate rollouts/entry only upon meeting gate. No authentic game or formal map allocated.
